title: Best User Testing Services (2026): How to Hire Testers
description: How to hire user testers for your website or app: what the service should include, how to write tasks, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: User testing means watching real people try your website or app while they think aloud. It shows where they get confused, what they expect and why they give up, which analytics alone cannot explain. Testing goes wrong when testers do not match your audience, tasks are leading, or results are a list of opinions with no clear actions. This guide helps you learn from testing quickly.

faq.q: How many testers do I need?
faq.a: Often a handful of well-chosen testers reveal most major problems in a flow. Test again after fixes rather than using many testers at once.
As closely as possible. A tech-savvy tester may breeze through steps your real customers find hard.
Usually screen and voice recordings, answers to questions and a summary of problems. Ask for time stamps of key moments.

faq.q: How is this different from QA testing?
faq.a: QA checks whether features work correctly. User testing checks whether people can understand and use them.

faq.q: Can I test designs before building?
faq.a: Yes. Testing a clickable prototype is cheaper than fixing a built product.
